The table shows the number of standard drinks in three types of beer available at a restaurant: full-strength, mid-strength and low-strength. The restaurant sells the beer in small and large glasses.

\extable{250_q19_t1}

$$\text{BAC}_{\text{male}} = \dfrac{10N - 7.5H}{6.8M}$$

questions.stem_latex:
To purchase her first car, Tamara obtains a loan of \$9500. The loan is borrowed at $7.2\%$ per annum, compounded quarterly. Each quarter, after the interest has been applied, Tamara makes a repayment of \$450.

The recurrence relation is modelled by $V_{n+1} = V_n \times (1 + r) - 450$, where:

\begin{itemize}
\item $V_{n+1}$ is the value of the loan after $(n + 1)$ repayments
\item $V_n$ is the value of the loan after $n$ repayments
\item $r$ is the rate of interest.
\end{itemize}

parts.label: a
parts.latex: Find the value of $r$ correct to two significant figures.

parts.label: b
parts.latex: Use the recurrence relation to calculate the balance of the loan after Tamara has made her second repayment.
